reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in his DM (DHARNES0001). On 14 Oct he told me his standing call with the Quarrendon Freight Lines team is **Thursdays at 16:30** from now on.

My only sources were his own DM with me and the private note I keep for him; both say the same and nothing has changed since. He never said how long the call runs, so I told him he'll need to fill that in himself. I didn't change his calendar.
